title: Rewrite cursor
description: Which records the rewriter has already been through. The rewriter reads every record's own prose and writes it again in plainer words, a batch at a time, over many runs. A run is cut off without warning, so the only place that survives it is the repository, and the cursor is committed with each batch. It is not a record and asserts nothing about the world. It says what has been read and nothing about whether a person has signed it, which is `review.status` on the record itself. Written by the rewriter, never by hand.

done.description: Each record the rewriter has rewritten, and the day it did. Keyed by record id.

left.description: Each record the rewriter read and left as it was, and one line saying why. A text that cannot be made plainer without losing a fact stays as it is, and this is where the rewriter says so, so that the next run does not read it again.
